description: 基準水位予測(南海トラフ巨大地震等) [earthquakes and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 【掲載しているデータはGISデータです】 ・公開データは、検討時点における調査研究成果や知見を踏まえて作成されたもので、今後の調査研究の進展により逐次見直されるべきものです。 ・基準水位とは、津波浸水想定に定める水深に係る水位に建築物等への衝突による津波の水位の上昇を考慮して必要と認められる値を加えて定める水位のことです。 ・基準水位は... Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 南海トラフ, 南海トラフ地震, 防災, 防災_安全安心. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-02-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
